00050 FFTEngine::FFTEngine(const int fftSize) throw()
00051 {
00052   if(fftSize <= 0)
00053   {
00054     // deault to 4096
00055     internal = new FFTEngineInternal(4096);
00056   }
00057   else if(fftSize < 16)
00058   {
00059     // less than 16 the fftSize is specified as a power of 2
00060     internal = new FFTEngineInternal(1 << fftSize);
00061   }
00062   else
00063   {
00064     // use fftSize directly, the internal rounds it up to a power of 2 if necessary
00065     internal = new FFTEngineInternal(fftSize);
00066   }
00067 }
00068 
00069 FFTEngine::FFTEngine(FFTEngine const& copy) throw()
00070 {
00071   internal = copy.internal;
00072   internal->incrementRefCount();
00073 }
00074 
00075 FFTEngine& FFTEngine::operator= (FFTEngine const& other) throw()
00076 {
00077   if (this != &other)
00078     {   
00079     internal->decrementRefCount();
00080     internal = other.internal;
00081     internal->incrementRefCount();
00082     }
00083   
00084     return *this;
00085 }

00184 Buffer FFTEngine::generatePhaseShiftResponse(FloatArray const& phases) throw()
00185 {
00186   if(phases.length() < 1) return Buffer();
00187   
00188   const int size = internal->size();
00189   const int halfSize = size >> 1;
00190 
00191   Buffer spectrum = Buffer::withSize(size, phases.length());
00192   Buffer response = Buffer::withSize(size, phases.length());
00193 
00194   for(int channel = 0; channel < phases.length(); channel++)
00195   {
00196     float phase = phases[channel];
00197     float real = cos(phase);
00198     float imag = sin(phase);
00199     
00200     spectrum.setSampleUnchecked(channel, 0, 0.f); // real DC
00201         
00202     // real
00203     for(int i = 1; i < halfSize; i++)
00204     {
00205       spectrum.setSampleUnchecked(channel, i, real);
00206     }
00207     
00208     spectrum.setSampleUnchecked(channel, halfSize, 0.f); // real Nyquist
00209     
00210     // imag
00211     for(int i = halfSize+1; i < size; i++)
00212     {
00213       spectrum.setSampleUnchecked(channel, i, imag);
00214     }
00215       
00216     // calculate
00217     ifft(response, spectrum, false, true, channel, channel);
00218   }
00219   
00220   // rotate response by halfSize samples
00221   response = response.getRegion(halfSize, size-1).append(response.getRegion(0, halfSize-1));
00222   return response;
00223 }
